slides.title: Things that are actually worth the money as a salon owner
slides.body: Some obvious. Some boring. All earned the hard way.

slides.title: Good shears.
slides.body: Obviously. Your wrists will thank you in ten years.

slides.title: A chair you can stand behind for 9 hours.
slides.body: Cheap hydraulics are a whole personality you don't want.

slides.title: Renewing your salon license before it lapses.
slides.body: Not the week after. Not "it's probably fine." Before.

slides.title: A copy of every stylist's license, with the expiration date written down.
slides.body: Booth renters included. Their dates are not the same as yours.

slides.title: Liability insurance that's actually current.
slides.body: Check the end date on the policy, not just that you have one.

slides.title: The boring stuff is cheap until it lapses.
slides.body: Save this for your next renewal season. What would you add?
